q: Is my journal data secure and private?
a: Yes, absolutely! Your entries are bound to your secure authenticated identity, stored with enterprise encryption in PostgreSQL, and never sold, shared, or indexed by public web crawlers.

q: How does mood tracking & emotional analytics work?
a: Every journal entry can be paired with one of over 20 tailored emotions. Our analytics dashboard automatically calculates emotional trends, streak consistency, and mood averages over weekly and monthly periods.

q: Can I organize my entries with collections and tags?
a: Yes! You can organize reflections into thematic collections (such as Gratitude, Career, Travel, or Health) and assign custom hashtags for instant filtering and discovery.

q: Can I set custom daily writing goals?
a: Yes! Reflct features a customizable daily word count target with real-time progress rings to motivate consistent daily writing habits.

q: Does Reflct support rich formatting and images?
a: Yes! The distraction-free rich text editor supports headings, bold, italics, blockquotes, bullet lists, and automatic mood-based aesthetic photography powered by Pixabay.

q: Can I access my journal on mobile devices?
a: Yes! Reflct is built mobile-first with responsive glassmorphic layouts that feel like a native app on iOS, Android, and tablets.
